---
title: "Rounded rectangle"
sidebar: api
---

`rounded_rectangle` creates a centered GDSFactory rounded rectangle and forwards its edge ports.

## Build the default component

~~~python
import gdsfactory as gf
import orcapen_sc_pdk

orcapen_sc_pdk.activate()
component = gf.get_component("rounded_rectangle")
~~~

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | 100 µm | Rectangle width. |
| `height` | 50 µm | Rectangle height. |
| `corner_radius` | 7 µm | Equal X and Y corner radii. |
| `n_corner_points` | 20 | GDSFactory sampling points per corner. |
| `ground_mask_margin` | 6 µm | Expand an optional mask outline. |
| `draw_layer` | `LAYER.D0_TOP_M1_DRAW` | DRAW layer. |
| `ground_mask_layer` | `None` | Optional mask layer. |
| `port_type` | `"electrical"` | Port type forwarded to GDSFactory. |

## Ports and layers

The default DRAW is a rounded rectangle on the D0 top M1 layer. GDSFactory edge ports are forwarded: side ports span `height - 2*corner_radius`, and top/bottom ports span `width - 2*corner_radius`. Setting `port_type=None` supplies no ports. An optional mask is a separate rectangle expanded by the margin and has no ports. This factory does not generate ETCH.

The radius must fit within half the smaller dimension. Each corner needs at least its two endpoints. The default margin is unused until a mask layer is supplied.

The [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/primitives.py) defines this factory.
